notes.text: Scan 078 has no visible author number at its head. A pale 77 appears at the lower left in another unnamed hand. H's introductory comment about continuation from another leaf is editorial material and is not copied into the manuscript transcription.

The author calls the opening object a système inductif de proespaces over the opposite ordering of the drapeaux of I and writes an underlined lim followed by est égalt and approximately X. He then introduces Z, writes the numbered expressions (55)–(58), and places homotopy-equivalence captions beside (56) and (57). This records the manuscript's statements. No proof, equality, implication or homotopy claim was checked.

The condition before (55) is heavily reworked at both ends. The left base preserves V-like and X-like contours with one exposed low i and a crowded raised star-candidate; the target preserves both X and Z contours. Both layer orders remain in place. The intervening subset sign is exposed and live. No target or layer order is chosen from the subsequent mathematical wording.

The eleven live V-like bases and the V-like layer in the overwritten condition retain plain/calligraphic alphabet uncertainty. These choices describe the written forms without assigning distinct mathematical roles. Every uncertain base preceding explicit indices/exponents has an outer TeX group because the uncertainty macro itself adds a raised question mark.

The raised middle contour in (56) is kept as 2|Z, with 2 first because of its rounded head. The nearby Z forms are recorded as written at their own positions. This reading makes no algebraic adjustment to the displayed map.

Continuation marks vary locally. The first two indices in the middle chain each contain one dash. Between its final intersections there is a point then a dash. The inline V index and the prose index sequence each contain two dashes. The source index of (57) contains a point and two dashes; its target has two dashes. These components are retained individually instead of replacing them by a uniform ellipsis.

The short word after Plus is retained as the doubtful literal généralt. The terminal t in égalt is on the word baseline, while the t after the inserted loc is visibly raised. The right-edge word has the visible prefix stratificati and a short terminal stroke reaching the edge; no unseen ending is supplied. The possible expansions of short forms are confined to the abbreviation list.

A tiny isolated point below the cancelled X after Soit Z, near original x703 and y586, has no established textual role. Two tiny points near the raised Z of (57), around x748–753 and y1870–1879, are likewise left unassigned. They are source-position observations in the audit comments, with no added punctuation or counted textual difference.

The least secure readings are the struck first-line word, the cancelled quantifier, the two overwritten bases, alphabet assignments, the shortened adverb, the struck fil-like group and the word ending at the right edge. The two witnesses sometimes supply a fuller word or a conventional ellipsis where fewer individual strokes are exposed. All nineteen first crops were explicitly read, and the unresolved portions remain marked at their positions.

main_review:
Main reader's whole-page inspection, recorded before any first-pass crop decisions.
The whole original scan was viewed once. The complete C and H texts, M0660 and all 23 packet difference rows were read. This note records that inspection; crop adjudications will be appended after the actual crop views.

No separate authorial page number is visible. Thin lower-left foliation 77 belongs to another hand.
The opening reads C'est un système inductif, with de and a cancellation followed by proespaces; the cancelled wording and its extent require a crop. The visible abbreviation ens has no evident stop. The parenthesis before l'inclusion, the following le/la under the limit and M0660 require close inspection. The relation before X has two wavy strokes.
The next paragraph has a cancelled X beside Soit Z, raised loc^t fermée, and a small crossed sign before un i tel que. The condition before (55) has an overwritten X/V-like base with crowded upper ink, a subset relation and an exposed final Z. The extent of cancellation must be read locally rather than assigned to the entire line.
Formula (55) reads a V expression with raised Z equal to an intersection with Z, followed by pro voisinage tubulaire de X_i^* dans Z. A crossed de/et-like group precedes On a. Formula (56) has two hooks between X_i^*, V_i^Z and V_i, with the equivalences d'homotopie wording below.
The longer formula following Plus généralement has the parenthetic condition X_{i_n} subset Z, several continuation clusters in the indices and intersections, and raised Z groups. Its precise clusters require crop inspection. After relatif a colon appears possible; the following article and crossed fil-like fragment before stratification require a crop. The ensuing Z_i definition, index sequence and formula (57) need their own literal signs retained.
The bottom paragraph introduces a part J of I and formula (58), containing the two unions with i in J and separate starred and plain X expressions.
The V forms have rounded U-like bowls; their alphabet is to be read independently on this leaf, with the cross-page notation review still pending. No mathematical proof has been checked during this whole-page reading.
